vigil.brief:
Vigil · study run — subject S99 · run 1

RUN 1 OF 2

Stop drones before they reach the ring

THE CLOCK
About three and a half minutes. The clock starts when you press Begin and cannot be paused.
ON THE MAP
Aircraft, broadcasting who they are. Escalating one is an error.
Drone, broadcasting its ID.
Unidentified track, broadcasting nothing.
The ring around the protected site.
Untouched,  opened,  escalated or dismissed.
WHAT YOU DO
Click a track to read it.
Escalate
if you think it will enter the ring. One click, and you are done with that track.
Dismiss
if it is not a concern.
WHAT COUNTS
Earlier is better. Escalate a track before it reaches the ring.
Escalating sends a response team. Do not escalate a track you do not believe is a threat.
THE PRIORITY LIST
The priority list on the left ranks every track. The top row needs you first.
Red is warning: it needs you now.
Begin
